en: A black‑and‑white historic view down a wide cobblestone street lined with two‑ to three‑storey townhouses. At the end of the street stands a large brick Gothic church with a tall, square tower bearing a clock, stepped gables and a steep roof. A few people, including children and a man with a handcart, walk along the nearly empty street. German shop signs are visible on the left‑ and right‑hand buildings.
